# 📖 English — Enumeration-Description Texts

Grade 4, Week 11! Let's learn how writers list and describe things. 📖

## 📋 What Is Enumeration-Description?
An **enumeration-description text** lists and describes many things and their details. Signal words like *"first, second, third, and finally"* show the **order** of items.

## 🖊️ Describing with Adjectives
**Example:** "The adobo is salty, savory, and aromatic." This sentence describes the adobo using **adjectives**.

## 🔤 Prefixes and Suffixes
- A **prefix** is added to the beginning of a word → *unhappy*
- A **suffix** is added to the **end** of a word.
- A word with an added prefix or suffix is called an **affixed word** → *joyful*

## ✅ Subject-Verb Agreement
Make sure your subject and verb match → *"The children run fast."*

**Key words:** enumeration, description, sequence, prefix, suffix, affixed word

Mathematics.summary_markdown:
# 🍕 Mathematics — Understanding Fractions

Grade 4, Week 11! Let's explore proper, improper, and mixed fractions. 🍕

## 🔢 Types of Fractions
- A **proper fraction** has a numerator smaller than its denominator → *1/2*
- An **improper fraction** has a numerator equal to or larger than the denominator → *9/4*
- A **mixed number** combines a whole number and a fraction → *7/4 = 1 3/4*

## ⚖️ Equivalent Fractions and Lowest Terms
- **Equivalent fractions** name the same amount → *1/2 = 4/8*
- A fraction is in **lowest terms** when the GCF of the numerator and denominator is 1 → *6/8 reduces to 3/4*

## 📊 What the Denominator Tells Us
The **denominator** tells us how many equal parts the whole is divided into.

**Key words:** proper fraction, improper fraction, mixed number, equivalent, lowest terms

Science.summary_markdown:
# 🫀 Science — Digestive, Respiratory, and Circulatory Systems

Grade 4, Week 11! Let's learn how three body systems work together. 🫀

## 🍽️ Digestive System
The **digestive system** breaks down food so the body can use it. Food enters through the **mouth**, and the **stomach** mixes it with gastric acid. The **small intestine** absorbs most nutrients into the bloodstream.

## 🫁 Respiratory System
The **respiratory system** (lungs and airways) takes in oxygen and releases carbon dioxide. The **lungs** are protected by the rib cage.

## ❤️ Circulatory System
The **heart** pumps blood through the body, carrying **oxygen and nutrients** to all body parts.

## 🤝 Working Together
These three systems work **together** to provide nutrients and oxygen to every cell in the body.

**Key words:** digestive system, respiratory system, circulatory system, heart

# 📚 Filipino — Alamat, Pabula, at Parabula

Grade 4, Linggo 11! Alamin natin ang iba't ibang uri ng maikling kwento. 📚

## 📖 Alamat, Pabula, at Parabula
- Ang **alamat** ay nagpapaliwanag ng pinagmulan ng isang bagay o kababalaghan.
- Ang **pabula** ay isang maikling kwento na ang mga tauhan ay mga hayop na nagsasalita.
- Ang layunin ng **parabula** ay magbigay ng aral sa pamamagitan ng halimbawa.
- Ang **anekdota** ay isang maikling kwentong nagtatanghal ng katangian ng isang tao.

Ang talatang deskriptibo ay nagbibigay ng detalyadong paglalarawan. Ang unang hakbang sa pagsulat nito ay **tukuyin ang paksa o bagay na ilalarawan**.

## 🔤 Panlapi
Sa pagbabago ng salita gamit ang panlapi: *"basa" + "-in" = "basain"*.

**Mahahalagang salita:** alamat, pabula, parabula, anekdota, panlapi

# 🖥️ EPP (ICT) — Parts of a Computer

Grade 4, Week 11! Let's learn about the parts inside and around a computer. 🖥️

## 🧠 The CPU
The **CPU (Central Processing Unit)** is the "brain" of the computer.

## 🔌 Input and Output Devices
- **Input** is data that goes INTO the computer → a **keyboard** is an input device.
- **Output** is what the computer produces → a **printer** is an output device, and the **monitor** displays information.
- The **mouse** lets you move the cursor on the screen.

## 💾 Hardware and Software
- **Hardware** is the physical parts of the computer you can touch.
- **Software** is the programs and applications that run on the computer.

## ⌨️ Good Habits
- **Touch typing** keeps your fingers resting on the home row keys.
- Hold the mouse with a **relaxed grip** to prevent strain.
- **Booting** means starting the computer so it loads the operating system.

**Key words:** CPU, input, output, hardware, software, booting

# 🗺️ Araling Panlipunan — Heograpiya ng Pilipinas

Grade 4, Week 11! Alamin natin ang heograpiya ng ating bansa. 🗺️

## 🌏 Lokasyon ng Pilipinas
Ang Pilipinas ay matatagpuan sa **Timog-Silangang Asya**, sa pagitan ng 4° at 21° Hilaga, 116° at 127° Silangan. Ito ay isang **kapuluan** — isang grupo ng humigit-kumulang **7,641 pulo**.

## ⛰️ Pisikal na Katangian
- Ang pisikal na heograpiya ay tumutukoy sa likas na katangian ng lugar tulad ng bundok at ilog.
- Ang **Bundok Apo** ang pinakamataas na bundok sa Pilipinas.
- Ang **Ilog Cagayan** ang pinakamahabang ilog.

## 🌊 Mga Karagatan sa Paligid
- Ang **Dagat Pasipiko** ay nasa Silangan.
- Ang **Dagat Timog Tsina** ay nasa Kanluran.

## 🏝️ Tatlong Pangkat ng Kapuluan
Ang Pilipinas ay binubuo ng tatlong pangunahing pangkat: **Luzon, Visayas, at Mindanao**.

**Mahahalagang salita:** kapuluan, lokasyon, heograpiya, Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao

# 🎯 GMRC — Self-Discipline and Responsibility

Grade 4, Week 11! Let's learn how self-discipline helps us reach our goals. 🎯

## 💪 Self-Discipline
**Self-discipline** means controlling your impulses and choosing what is right — like studying first before playing, or following a study schedule every day.

## ✅ Responsibility and Accountability
- Taking **responsibility** for your actions means accepting the results of your choices.
- An **accountable** person takes ownership of their actions and admits mistakes with **integrity and courage**.

## ⏰ Managing Time and Goals
Managing your time well lets you finish tasks without rushing and still have time for leisure. Setting **goals** helps you stay focused on what's important — while procrastinating shows poor self-discipline.

**Key words:** self-discipline, responsibility, accountability, goals

# 🎵 MAPEH — Music Dynamics and Healthy Living

Grade 4, Week 11! Let's explore music volume and staying healthy. 🎵

## 🔊 Dynamics and Timbre
- **Dynamics** refers to the volume (loudness or softness) of music. **Piano (p)** means soft, **Forte (f)** means loud.
- **Timbre** is the unique quality or "color" of a sound that identifies it.
- The **harana** (Philippine serenade) is a local musical performance style.

## 🏃 Physical Education
- **Target games** involve throwing or hitting an object at a target.
- Good sportsmanship means **respecting opponents and accepting results gracefully**.
- **Jogging** develops cardiovascular fitness.

## 🌙 Personal Health
Personal health includes hygiene, proper nutrition, rest, and exercise. Getting enough **sleep** helps the body grow, repair, and stay healthy.

**Key words:** dynamics, timbre, sportsmanship, personal health
